run_f_gold_parity: run f_gold to compute the parity of an unsigned integer using Brian Kernighan algorithm
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple integer inputs to verify parity calculation correctness
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use built-in bin count method instead of bitwise loop
review_f_gold: review f_gold parity computation using the n & (n-1) bit clearing technique
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which toggles parity for each set bit until n becomes zero
